California Voters Reject Billionaire Wealth Tax Proposal

Californians have rejected a proposed 5% wealth tax targeting billionaires. The tax, known as Proposition 40, would have applied to the total wealth of targeted billionaires, including assets like shares and income. US media projections indicated the defeat of the proposal.
